form.label: Network
form.description: Company and job title reflect the exported profile, not employment at the connection date. Cumulative totals use all dated connections in the selected snapshot.

search.query: index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:* earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=* | stats count BY member_id | eval member_label=if(member_id="personal","Personal",member_id) | fields member_id member_label

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | eval label=snapshot_time." — ".status | fields label export_id
index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | head 1 | fields export_id

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | dedup export_id | table snapshot_time snapshot_time_basis status actual_records warning_count export_id

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=connection time_basis=activity | timechart span=1mon count AS Added

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=connection time_basis=activity | timechart span=1mon count AS Added | streamstats sum(Added) AS Connections | fields _time Connections

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=connection | where company!="" | stats count AS Connections BY company | sort - Connections | head 20

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=connection | where job_title!="" | stats count AS Connections BY job_title | sort - Connections | head 20

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=connection | sort - _time | table first_name last_name company job_title connected_on url

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=connection | stats count AS total count(eval(company="" OR isnull(company))) AS missing_company count(eval(job_title="" OR isnull(job_title))) AS missing_title
